capabilities: Research a selected term from the editor context menu
Run either a quick search or a deep research pass
Show overview, report and sources in a side panel
Insert a link into the current note
Save results as a knowledge card
extras: Desktop only. API keys are stored through Obsidian SecretStorage and are never written to prompts, logs or data.json. The README is written in both English and Chinese.
problem: Looking up unfamiliar companies, technologies or supply-chain terms means leaving Obsidian and losing track of where the answers came from.

relations.evidence: The plugin supports OpenAI Responses, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints
The plugin supports OpenAI Responses, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints (including CPA accounts with web_search), and GLM.

summary: Desktop-only plugin that runs cited AI web research on a selected term and shows the results in a side panel.
